Assistant B is clearly better. It correctly extracts the requested fields for all three books and follows the specified format of "main character, book, author, year of publication," one book per line. Its values match the source texts: Harry Potter (1997), Frodo Baggins (1954), and Zylo (2028).

Assistant A says "I'm sorry, I don't understand the question." The request is clear and answerable, so this response provides nothing useful.

[[B]]
